groups.title: Check the latest threats and alerts
groups.description: Sites that publish information on new attack methods and vulnerabilities that need action right away. Make a habit of looking about once a week. Most of these sites are in Japanese.

sites.name: IPA: Important Security Information
sites.description: Summarizes countermeasures for users on highly urgent vulnerabilities and attacks. (Japanese)

sites.name: JPCERT/CC: Alerts
sites.description: Alerts on vulnerabilities and attacks that may cause widespread damage in Japan. Aimed at staff in organizations. (Japanese)

sites.name: JVN (vulnerability countermeasure information portal)
sites.description: Vulnerabilities and countermeasures for products used in Japan. Run jointly by JPCERT/CC and IPA. (Japanese)

sites.name: Council of Anti-Phishing Japan: Urgent Information
sites.description: Shows real phishing emails and fake sites currently in circulation, with screenshots. (Japanese)

sites.name: National Police Agency: Cyber Affairs Bureau
sites.description: Publishes the state of cybercrime (such as statistics on ransomware damage) and alerts. (Japanese)

sites.name: CISA KEV Catalog
sites.description: A list of vulnerabilities confirmed to have been exploited. Used for prioritizing responses. (English)

groups.title: Learn from the basics (for beginners)
groups.description: Easy-to-follow materials made by public bodies for the general public.

sites.name: IPA: Koko kara Security! (Security starts here)
sites.description: A portal that gathers learning materials and consultation services on information security. (Japanese)

sites.name: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications: Cybersecurity Site for the Public
sites.description: Explains things systematically, from basic knowledge to measures at home and at work. (Japanese)

sites.name: Handbook for Safe and Secure Internet Use
sites.description: A handbook on using the internet safely, produced by the national body in charge of cybersecurity. (Japanese)

sites.name: IPA: 10 Major Security Threats
sites.description: The threats getting attention now, announced every year. There is an edition for individuals and one for organizations. (Japanese)

sites.name: IPA: Information Security Safety Consultation Service
sites.description: Where to turn in Japan when you think you may have been hit by a virus or a scam. (Japanese)

groups.title: Learn in more depth (intermediate to advanced)
groups.description: Information on certification exams, and materials that professionals refer to in their work.

sites.name: IPA: Information Security Management Examination
sites.description: A Japanese national examination on managing information security in organizations. A good goal for the intermediate level. (Japanese)

sites.name: IPA: Registered Information Security Specialist Examination
sites.description: A Japanese national qualification for security professionals. A good goal for the advanced level. (Japanese)

sites.name: IPA: How to Secure Your Website
sites.description: A standard resource for developers that explains the typical vulnerabilities of web applications and how to counter them. (Japanese)

sites.name: OWASP Top 10
sites.description: A ranking of the most serious security risks for web applications. It is revised every few years. (English)

sites.name: MITRE ATT&CK
sites.description: A knowledge base that organizes attackers' tactics and techniques from real attack cases. (English)

sites.name: NIST SP 800-61 (incident response)
sites.description: Incident response guidance from the US NIST (Rev. 3, revised in 2025). It is referred to around the world. (English)

groups.title: Practice hands-on (legal practice environments)
groups.description: Always practice attacks in an environment where you have permission.

sites.name: picoCTF
sites.description: A CTF (a game of competing in security skills) for beginners. You learn by solving challenges. (English)

sites.name: OWASP Juice Shop
sites.description: A practice web application made vulnerable on purpose. You run it on your own PC to practice. (English)
